name: A product team, first draft
description: A made-up first draft of a small product team's operation: a cloud account that builds and tests the product, a laptop with a long-lived diagram session, and a second vendor's tool, linked only by repositories and by Ada carrying prompts. Assumed, to be corrected by the lead: how the research lanes hand work to each other; that the second tool is given its prompts by hand and returns work through a branch; how many test runners and routines there are.

sessions.name: Operator
sessions.role: Keeps the plan; starts and steers the worker sessions, test runners and routines

sessions.name: Worker lanes
sessions.role: Each builds one piece of the product on its own branch

sessions.name: Test runners
sessions.role: Run the test suites against a branch and report what failed

sessions.name: Scheduled routines
sessions.role: Wake on a schedule to check on the work and nudge the Operator

sessions.name: Research lanes
sessions.role: A private research project, worked in its own cloud sessions

sessions.name: Diagram session
sessions.role: Builds the diagram tool: exports, operation maps and the live view the Operator will use

sessions.name: Codex
sessions.model: GPT-6.1 Sol and other OpenAI models

handoffs.what: a task prompt for each lane, and steering while it runs
finished work, one pull request per lane
test results, committed beside the work
a wake-up with what changed since the last one
work passed from one research lane to the next
the brief for this round, pasted into a fresh session
a short page on the map format and how to run the live view
prompts carried to Codex by hand
Codex's work, on a branch the Operator can fetch
